role: The entity registry: the name/id/class maps the static block fills, the factories createEntityByName/createEntityFromNBT/createEntityByID, and the spawn-egg colours.
scope_reason: Snapshot reload and the spawners both build entities from names and ids.

members.name: stringToClassMapping
members.note: name-to-kind as per-path tables (the spawner id list, the reload switch), not one global map

members.name: classToStringMapping
members.note: kind-to-name in living.c's living_kind_name and the per-kind NBT writers

members.name: IDtoClassMapping
members.note: the spawner ids the port covers (zombie, skeleton, spider, cave spider, silverfish, blaze, creeper, enderman, witch, pigman and the four animals)

members.name: classToIDMapping
members.note: getEntityID's class lookup: the native writers carry the numeric id directly; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: stringToIDMapping
members.note: unused by the ported paths; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: entityEggs
members.note: the creative spawn-egg colours; no spawn eggs in the ported scenarios; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: addMapping
members.note: static init; the native tables are generated and checked against the oracle

members.name: createEntityByName
members.note: the constructor side is exact for every ported kind (ai.c:an_construct_kind, the per-kind construct functions); the registry is per-path tables rather than one map; EntityEgg has no mapping, so a travelling egg gets no copy (serverreplay.c sr_ie_portal_travel, portal-proj-s1)

members.name: createEntityFromNBT
members.note: the Minecart Type switch is unreachable (minecarts off); the constructor + readFromNBT order and the Det draws are reproduced; the Nether's and the End's reloads take the overworld's path (nether-unload-kinds-s1, end-unload-kinds-s1)

members.name: getEntityID
members.note: the class-to-id lookup; the native writers carry the id; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getClassFromID
members.note: the spawner ids the port covers

members.name: EntityEggInfo.ctor
members.note: the spawn-egg colours and the two stats; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: EntityList
members.note: n/a: a static-only class; nothing in oracle/src constructs it (no new EntityList())

notes: '/summon refuses switched-off entities' lives in dev.c (the summon path), which is where createEntityByName's guard sits in this port. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): runtime registry replaced by the generated blocks.h/items.h tables; nothing registers at runtime. Formerly listed as missing: getEntityID, getStringFromID and entityEggs: no spawn-egg or numeric-id consumer exists in the ported paths. The registry itself is a set of per-path tables (spawner ids, reload switch, kind names) rather than one map; a new entity kind must touch each. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-hanging-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
